about: Volter Editor's Poly Haven asset browser and import as they ship (volter-ai/editor b86dde8c5618, packages/editor-core/server/asset-library-routes.ts, types removed): its own fetch, no SDK and no key (Poly Haven's API is public), reads the model categories, lists the furniture models, shows a thumbnail from the URL it builds, reads the armchair's files and downloads its 1k glTF with each include, asserting the imported bytes. The catalog holds only what is published to it, so the app publishes the armchair first through the World's publisher door.

files..env.example: # Poly Haven's API is public: the editor sends no key

retention.none: The editor only reads Poly Haven's public catalog and downloads its files: it stores nothing at Poly Haven, holds no account or key there, and its import lands on its own disk, so there is no vendor record of the app's to read back.
